name_reason: Current name has two defects: (1) the '_52758' suffix is a pure Ghidra address residue equal to the operand address 0x52758 (the global it touches) and must be removed; (2) 'set_word' is wrong -- the body reads/writes a dword (32-bit pointer), not a word. The function is a get-and-set (swap) helper for the AIL internal allocator slot data_ail_alloc_fnptr (0x52758): it stores the new fnptr and returns the prior one. Proposed fd2_ail_set_alloc_fnptr follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ail, matching the global data_ail_alloc_fnptr) and conveys the install-allocator semantics. The sibling @ 0x3616E (swaps data_ail_free_fnptr) would correspondingly become fd2_ail_set_free_fnptr.
purpose: Install a new AIL internal allocator function pointer (data_ail_alloc_fnptr at 0x52758) and return the previous one, so a caller can save/restore or compare it.
logic_summary: EAX = [0x52758] (old allocator fnptr); EDX = [ESP+4] (new fnptr arg); [0x52758] = EDX (store new); RET (return old in EAX). A get-and-set/swap of a single dword pointer slot. No stack frame, no __CHK; raw register passing, 1 cdecl stack param. The AIL_internal_* load/alloc routines call indirectly through data_ail_alloc_fnptr to allocate; game main patches malloc into it at startup. 0 static callers of this function (it is the API entry; the slot itself is read by AIL_internal_load_file_to_memory, AIL_internal_alloc_and_commit, AIL_internal_mdi_driver_setup_full and the CRT loader).

params.name: new_val
params.semantics: New AIL allocator function pointer to install into data_ail_alloc_fnptr (a 32-bit code pointer, e.g. &malloc). Stored as-is; the prior value is returned.
params.reason: new_val is acceptable (not a generic param_1, no address residue) but imprecise; the value is specifically a function pointer being installed into the allocator slot, so new_fnptr is more accurate. Minor clarity rename only; type/semantics unchanged.

returns.semantics: The previous value of data_ail_alloc_fnptr (the allocator function pointer in effect before this call), returned in EAX. Lets the caller restore or compare the old allocator.

comment_original_issue: src comment was terse ('Swap AIL alloc function pointer. Returns old value.') and did not identify the target as the AIL internal allocator slot, that the value is a dword pointer (the name says 'word'), that there are no static callers, or the relationship to the consuming AIL_internal_* routines and the +4 free-slot sibling.
notes: data_ail_alloc_fnptr (0x52758) holds 0x36d16 statically (= malloc, confirmed by DATA xref from this function's address region) and the +4 slot 0x5275c holds 0x37416 (= free). The Ghidra decompiler 'fixup to -> 00002758' annotations are LE-relocation display artifacts; the real disassembly operand is the absolute address 0x52758 = data_ail_alloc_fnptr (confirmed via disassemble_function and get_xrefs_from). Old plate had a misleading speculative tail ('0x52758 appears in fix_off32 table cross-references suggesting it may be reached via function pointer') that conflated the global's data xrefs with this function being invoked; corrected in the refined plate. Both rename (function + param) recorded only; not applied this stage (Stage 2).
